tasks.prompt: Create a concise provisional business plan for an unpaid-interview-first Swiss service helping elderly households compare home-care options. No local customer research, reachable market counts, prices or founder budget are known. Synthetic comparison evidence: a US provider exists; a Japanese provider closed after an expensive expansion. A VC feed returned 2 current and 1 prior rounds in equal periods, both capped. Address the nine business-plan sections, research sources and exact next tests; do not invent facts, imply local demand or authorize execution.

Create a concise provisional business plan for a Swiss B2B SaaS tool automating repair-shop scheduling. Synthetic inputs: interviewees report duplicate scheduling; there are no paying users. An overseas analog has reported repeat paying users but audited profitability is unavailable. Use explicitly hypothetical monthly assumptions CHF100 price, 10 customers, CHF20 direct cost per customer, CHF1500 fixed costs, CHF10000 opening cash, no acquisition spend; calculate revenue, contribution and runway without calling it a forecast. Include all nine plan sections, transfer conditions and research decisions.

Assess a Swiss consumer subscription assisting households with recurring administrative tasks and prepare its provisional business plan. Synthetic comparison evidence: Japanese company J has many signups but no retention or purchases disclosed, and company K failed expansion into Europe. OpenAlex returned a study title about household administrative burden but no abstract or full text. VC feed has an undisclosed round amount, startup as subject, round as object, type investor.joined_round; investor identity is unavailable. Keep study metadata, commercial precedent, funding and local customer evidence distinct, and define research and plan sections without fabricating missing evidence.

limitations: Three synthetic cases, one trial per arm
Coordinator review is unblinded and uncalibrated
No real-case research quality or customer demand established
